title: DILG chief: Atong Ang may have left PH ‘backdoor’ a year ago
summary: MANILA, Philippines—Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said he has been getting information about gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang leaving the country through the “backdoor”…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Interior and Local Government Secretary Jonvic Remulla said he has been getting information about gambling tycoon Charlie “Atong” Ang leaving the country through the “backdoor” since last year. Remulla only revealed the update on Tuesday due to the process of verification. “The information has been under our analysis for one year,” Remulla told Inquirer
